fields.description: Schedule — run at set times. Document Event — run each time a record is created, changed, or submitted. Document Event needs a Document Query source, and reads only the record that changed from it. Incoming Email — run when a message arrives in a Frappe inbox; Crema adds the source row for you. Webhook — run only when another system calls the address below.
fields.label: Trigger
fields.options:
Schedule
Document Event
Incoming Email
Webhook

fields.description: Pick how often this task runs. Choose Custom (or leave this empty) to write the timing yourself in the field below.
fields.label: How Often
fields.options:
Every 15 minutes
Hourly
Daily 03:00
Weekly (Mon 03:00)
Custom

fields.description: A cron expression, for example 0 3 * * * for 03:00 every day. Crema checks for due tasks every 15 minutes, so a task set to run more often than that still runs only once per check. The box above fills this in unless you pick Custom.
fields.label: Custom Schedule (cron)

fields.description: Which change to a record starts this task: when one is created, changed, or submitted.
fields.label: Event
fields.options:
After Insert
On Update
On Submit

fields.description: Send a POST to this address to run the task. Sign in with a Frappe API key and secret; the account needs read access to this task. Anything you send in the payload field is read by the AI alongside the sources, while Use Webhook Data is on.
fields.label: Endpoint

fields.description: Read what the calling system sends as one more source, alongside the rows below. Switch this off to ignore it and read only the sources.
fields.label: Use Webhook Data

fields.description: Everything this task reads. Add a row per web address or kind of record; a task can mix them. Each run reads them all and hands the AI one combined text. You choose the sources yourself — the AI never picks one. A Webhook task may leave this empty while Use Webhook Data is on, and read only what is sent to it.
fields.label: Sources

fields.description: Stop the whole run when one source cannot be read, for example a web address that is down. Leave this off to run with the sources that did work and note the failure. Either way, a run where every source failed counts as failed.
fields.label: Stop if a Source Fails

fields.description: Which AI profile this task runs as. The profile decides the AI provider, the model, the spending limit, and the account the task acts as. Set them up in Crema Settings.
fields.label: AI Profile

fields.description: The account this task acts as: it reads and writes only what that account may. Leave empty to use the account set for this use case in Crema Settings.
fields.label: Runs As

fields.description: Say in plain English what to take from the source and what to do with it.
fields.label: Instruction

fields.description: Create or Update Records — add new records, or change them if they already exist. Update the Records It Read — change only the records this task read; it never adds one, and it needs exactly one Document Query source. No Changes — write nothing, just save the answer.
fields.label: Action
fields.options:
Create or Update Records
Update the Records It Read
No Changes

fields.description: The only kind of record this task can create or change. Crema checks every run against it, so the task can never write anywhere else.
fields.label: Record Type to Write

fields.description: Email addresses to send the result to after each successful run, separated by commas. Works with any action: a task that writes records emails what it did. Leave empty to only save it on this task.
fields.label: Email Report To

fields.description: How this task decided to handle the source. Crema works it out on the first run and reuses it afterwards. It is a set of instructions, never code, and it is rewritten whenever you change what this task reads, writes, or is told to do.
fields.label: Plan

fields.description: An existing record with the same value in these fields is updated instead of a new one being created.
fields.label: Finds Existing Records By
What the AI Is Asked to Pull Out

fields.description: The full plan as stored. Read-only — clear it only if you want Crema to start over.
fields.label: Raw Plan (JSON)

fields.description: When this task is due to run next. Empty while the task is switched off.
fields.label: Next Run

fields.description: What the last run did: how many records it handled, or the report text if this task only reports.
fields.label: Last Result

fields.description: How many runs failed in a row. Crema switches the task off at 5. A successful run resets this to 0.
fields.label: Consecutive Failures
